name: @pipeworx/mcp-biostudies

tools.name: search_studies
tools.description: Search EBI BioStudies — a keyless database of biological study descriptions that links across EBI archives (ArrayExpress, PRIDE, etc.). Find studies by keyword and get accession, title, authors, type, release date, and link/file counts.

limit.description: Max results per page, default 15, max 100.

tools.name: get_study
tools.description: Get the metadata for a single EBI BioStudies study by accession (e.g. "S-EPMC6010251"). Returns the title, flattened attributes (abstract, release date, data source, etc.), and counts of links and subsections. EBI BioStudies links across EBI archives. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-biostudies forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the biostudies pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
